agent_operating_rules: Read motto_v4.md, .agent/AGENT_KICKOFF_PROMPT.txt, the signed product constitution, relevant ADRs, and current session context before editing.
Re-check repository HEAD and all listed files before acting because parallel work may have landed.
Do not create a parallel implementation. Replace, migrate, or converge the canonical path.
Do not use mutating git commands. Work against current files and report intended changes.
Every task must include behavioral tests, migration/recovery behavior, documentation updates, and an acceptance report.
Do not declare success from no-crash tests, source-string assertions, comments, or local mocks that bypass the real cross-layer contract.

tasks.title: Sign doctrine and remove prohibited product surface
tasks.objective: Make one product constitution canonical and remove launch behavior that contradicts it.
implementation: Record operator approval or rejection of the proposed constitution.
Remove What-If from routes, navigation, tests, copy, analytics, and release assets.
Remove or explicitly quarantine speculative smart-guidance copy.
Add an allowed-capability registry and a release test for prohibited surfaces.
acceptance: No premium or coverage estimate formula ships.
No /what-if route exists in a production build.
One signed doctrine document has precedence over all other product documents.
Decision log records rationale and migration impact.

tasks.title: Freeze shared cross-layer wire contracts
tasks.objective: Create one source for claims, consent, capabilities, upload, and Q&A schemas shared by Dart, FastAPI, tests, and documentation.
implementation: Choose OpenAPI/JSON Schema or an equivalent canonical schema source.
Generate or validate Dart and Pydantic representations.
Define strict error/result unions and forward compatibility.
acceptance: Undocumented fields fail contract tests.
Mobile and backend types are generated or mechanically checked.
Contract version is visible in runtime responses.
Claims id mismatch is caught before app code runs.

tasks.title: Rebuild claims synchronization
tasks.objective: Deliver lossless create, update, delete, pagination, retry, and conflict behavior.
implementation: Use cursor pagination and never treat one page as the full snapshot.
Add idempotency keys and conflict policy.
Preserve filed_date where product semantics require it.
acceptance: Real mobile POST succeeds against FastAPI.
More than 200 claims reconcile without local deletion.
Timeout after server create does not duplicate.
Offline create/edit/delete survives process death.
Malformed success response is not success.
Concurrent device/server edit follows documented conflict policy.

Anonymous refresh does not become account transition.
Network loss at every identity-link stage recovers.
Account A work cannot commit under account B.
Process death does not lose claim intent.
Old principal data is inaccessible after transition policy.

Migration survives kill at every stage.

Clear Data does not delete unrelated app files.
Residual ciphertext is unrecoverable after key erasure.
Android and iOS backup behavior is documented and tested.
